mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (real GDP) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 5-day window, or 5-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased policy rates compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative in tightening cycles (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (real GDP) and HOUST (hourly employment) signal robust demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise simultaneously (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE >4.5%), a sustained rise in UNRATE triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened policy tightening concerns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative in high-unemployment regimes (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 110 signals contractionary supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive in contractionary supply regimes (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS (monetary policy) and UNRATE (labor market) indicate tightening conditions, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary and labor market conditions
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both proxies rise simultaneously (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation index) signals deflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive in deflationary regimes (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO drops >10% in 3 months), a contraction in supply triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased demand pressures.
regime_hint: supply shock regime (INDPRO drops >10% in 3 months)
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive in supply shock regimes (t-test p >0.05).
